changes.label: Narrative
changes.before: Discretionary spending remains more resilient in some experiences than in every goods category. Reuters reports Delta expecting summer demand to produce record second-quarter revenue. [[n1027]] This is company guidance for a future quarter, not revenue already earned. The attraction depends on how much demand can become profitable capacity.
changes.after: Discretionary spending remains more resilient in some experiences than in every goods category. Skift reports Delta posting record revenues as corporate travel rebounds. [[n1026]] The reported revenue strength gives the travel case an operating anchor. Its investment value still depends on the capacity, staffing and service costs needed to sustain profitable demand.
